title: Research rents and mail a report
summary: Nova searches the web, reads two pages (one refuses), runs a script on its computer, writes a report, and proposes mailing it.

steps.text: They want this month's rent prices for Lisbon, a short report, and the report mailed to Sam.
Search first, read the two most useful pages, then work the numbers out on the computer rather than by hand.
